title: Employ staff under the Professional Diving Industry (Industrial) Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Professional Diving Industry (Industrial) Award 2020.

sources.title: Professional Diving Industry (Industrial) Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the professional industrial diving industry and their employees in the classifications listed in Schedule A —Classification Definitions to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.condition: underwater services to industry, including offshore diving (cl 4.2)
reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Professional Diving Industry (Industrial) Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 In this award, the professional industrial diving industry means the provision of underwater services to industry and includes offshore exploration and development diving and related shipboard services.

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: No ABS class is for diving; the classes are those where underwater services to industry are done (cl 4.2).

assessment.summary: The Professional Diving Industry (Industrial) Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
